body_lead: Gujarat has unveiled a comprehensive financial support framework for artificial intelligence (AI) startups and announced plans for a ‘Sovereign AI Park’, as Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel held direct consultations with emerging technology firms in Gandhinagar. The measures were outlined during a startup dialogue organised by the state’s Science and Technology Department at the Chief Minister’s residence, where around 24 high-potential startups from across India presented their innovations and products.
